analysis.purpose: cmdIndex implements the `crib index` CLI command. It performs a full rebuild of the knowledge graph for a target repository: resolves the repo root, parses exclusions and the --semantic flag, creates a fresh soul store, runs the indexing pipeline, builds and closes the search index, registers the indexed repo, and prints statistics plus a pending-LLM hint.
responsibilities: Resolve the repository root from cwdOverride, path argument, or current directory
Parse the --semantic flag and exclusion patterns
Create a fresh soul store for rebuild via freshSoulForRebuild
Run the indexing pipeline via indexRepo
Build and close the search index
Print indexing statistics and elapsed time
Print a hint about pending LLM graph targets
